verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official MCP server that connects Claude, Cursor, Windsurf or any MCP client directly to a Bolna account, so users can operate it by talking to their AI assistant. Agent Studio also turns a short natural-language description into a call-ready agent. Natural-language control of the wider account depends on an external MCP client, and the evidence does not show which operations the MCP tools expose. Missing for 10: a documented list of the operations the MCP tools cover, a native natural-language command interface beyond agent creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client to your Bolna account with the Bolna MCP server.
The Bolna MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your Bolna account over the Model Context Protocol
Agent Studio turns a short description of your use case into a production-grade, call-ready voice AI agent — in 5 to 8 minutes.
